headline: 34 RI Pension Funds Fall Within 5 Years, OJK Head Reveals the Cause
summary: The number of pension fund operators in Indonesia declined from 213 in 2021 to 179 as of August 2026, according to the financial regulator OJK.
why: The OJK (Financial Services Authority) supervises Indonesia's pension funds and insurance sector. Pension funds are large institutional investors in local capital markets.
original_headline: 34 Dapen RI Berguguran Dalam 5 Tahun, Bos OJK Ungkap Penyebabnya
